output.summary: Arts' 9-day median is mostly explained by SlotBook tickets auto-routed to P4 best-effort (21-day median; removing them closes 70% of the gap). Matched non-SlotBook tickets show no Arts deprioritisation. Most of the remaining gap is Lindqvist's twice-weekly on-site coverage. Tickets carried a generic acknowledgement with no status or timeframe. Whether ITS told Arts leadership of RR-17 is unresolved: the accounts conflict and the records are silent. The SlotBook ticket rise after September 2025 may reflect the SSO change, the category's creation or term timing, so it is unestablished. Preferred actions are written SlotBook support terms with a corrected acknowledgement, plus split reporting. Moving Arts to CampusBook now, an Arts-run desk, or an Arts-wide best-effort track are unjustified or harmful.
